# QR code and PDF (QRC)

The tax QR code on every invoice: when it exists, what it encodes, and how any document that carries it presents it.

Rules page: https://docs.beel.es/rules/qr

"Checked by: Your integration" or "The issuing business" means BeeL. does not enforce the rule, beyond any error codes it lists: the integration has to.

## QRC-001

**Every invoice carries the tax QR code**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. does this for you.

An invoice issued with a billing system carries the tax QR code, whether it is a full or a simplified invoice. BeeL. returns the QR data on the invoice and prints the QR on every PDF it renders for an invoice under VeriFactu.

**Why:** The QR is how the recipient checks the invoice with AEAT. A document without it is not the invoice the regulation describes.

**Applies to:** operations `getCompanyInvoicePdf`; Invoices of a company under VeriFactu, full or simplified.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.5.a) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6
- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 7.5 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a7

**Incorrect:** Sending the customer a document of your own with the invoice data and no QR.

**Correct:** Sending the PDF BeeL. renders, which carries the QR, or printing qr_base64 on your own document.

**Related:** QRC-002, QRC-005, QRC-003

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf#rendering-your-own-pdf

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/QRC-001.md

## QRC-002

**Wait for the QR before you distribute the PDF**

`MUST NOT` · BeeL. rule · Impact: critical · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Do not render or send an invoice under VeriFactu before its QR exists. The QR data appears with submission_status: PENDING, a few seconds after issuing; BeeL. generates the final PDF only then, and the invoice.pdf.generated webhook says it is ready.

**Why:** Right after the issue call the invoice reads NOT_SUBMITTED and has no QR. A document rendered at that moment goes out without it.

**Applies to:** operations `issueCompanyInvoice`, `getCompanyInvoicePdf`; Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

**Incorrect:** Rendering your own PDF from the response of the issue call, which carries no qr_url yet.

**Correct:** Waiting for the invoice.pdf.generated webhook, or reading the invoice again until verifactu.qr_url is present.

**Related:** QRC-001, REC-008

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf#the-final-pdf-waits-for-the-qr · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf#the-qr-exists-from-pending

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/QRC-002.md

## QRC-003

**The QR measures between 30 mm and 40 mm**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

The QR code printed on an invoice measures at least 30 mm × 30 mm and at most 40 mm × 40 mm.

**Why:** A smaller QR may not scan, and the Orden fixes the range: neither smaller nor larger.

**Applies to:** Any document that carries the QR, including one you render.

**Legal basis:**

- Orden HAC/1177/2024, art. 21.1 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2024-22138#a2-3
- AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU, Remisión de información por el receptor / QR — https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/iva/sistemas-informaticos-facturacion-verifactu/preguntas-frecuentes/posibilidad-remision-informacion-factura-parte-receptor.html

**Incorrect:** Scaling the qr_base64 image down to fit a narrow header.

**Correct:** Placing the image at a fixed physical size inside the range, whatever the page layout.

**Related:** QRC-004, QRC-009, QRC-008

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf#rendering-your-own-pdf

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/QRC-003.md

## QRC-004

**The QR follows ISO/IEC 18004 with error correction M**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

A QR code generated for an invoice follows ISO/IEC 18004 and uses error-correction level M. Set it when you encode qr_url with your own library.

**Why:** Other levels change the density of the code, and the Orden fixes this one.

**Applies to:** A QR you generate yourself from qr_url.

**Legal basis:**

- Orden HAC/1177/2024, art. 21.1 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2024-22138#a2-3

**Incorrect:** Encoding qr_url with a library that defaults to error-correction level L.

**Correct:** Encoding it with level M, or printing qr_base64 unchanged.

**Related:** QRC-003, QRC-005

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf#rendering-your-own-pdf

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/QRC-004.md

## QRC-005

**Use qr_url exactly as returned**

`MUST NOT` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. does this for you.

Do not build or change the URL the QR encodes: use qr_url as BeeL. returns it. It carries only the four parameters AEAT requires, the issuer NIF, the number, the issue date and the amount AEAT registered.

**Why:** The URL has to match the registered record. A URL built from your own invoice total, or with extra parameters, points AEAT at an invoice that does not exist.

**Applies to:** Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

**Legal basis:**

- Orden HAC/1177/2024, art. 21.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2024-22138#a2-3
- AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0), apartado 6 — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/DetalleEspecificacTecnCodigoQRfactura.pdf

**Incorrect:** Rebuilding the URL from your own data, with the invoice total including IRPF, or adding formato=json.

**Correct:** Encoding the qr_url string from the invoice, unchanged.

```json
{ "verifactu": { "qr_url": "https://www2.agenciatributaria.gob.es/wlpl/TIKE-CONT/ValidarQR?nif=B27534239&numserie=S-2026-0001&fecha=19-09-2026&importe=121.00" } }
```

**Related:** QRC-001, QRC-004

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf#rendering-your-own-pdf · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/what-aeat-receives#the-total

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/QRC-005.md

## QRC-006

**The VeriFactu legend goes just below the QR**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Just below the QR, print «Factura verificable en la sede electrónica de la AEAT» or «VERI*FACTU», in a type size at least equal to the rest of the invoice data. Print it only on invoices whose record goes to AEAT.

**Why:** The legend tells the recipient the invoice was sent to AEAT and can be checked there; on an invoice that was not, it would say something false.

**Applies to:** Any document that carries the QR of an invoice registered under VeriFactu.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.5.b) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6
- AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0), apartado 3 — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/DetalleEspecificacTecnCodigoQRfactura.pdf

**Incorrect:** Printing the legend in small print in the footer, away from the QR.

**Correct:** Printing «Factura verificable en la sede electrónica de la AEAT» centred just below the QR, as large as the invoice lines.

**Related:** QRC-007, QRC-003

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf#the-legend-next-to-the-qr

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/QRC-006.md

## QRC-007

**«QR tributario:» goes just above the QR**

`MUST` · AEAT criterion · Impact: medium · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Above the QR, print the text «QR tributario:», preferably centred on it, in a type size at least equal to the rest of the invoice data.

**Why:** AEAT's specification presents the QR with this label, so that the recipient knows which code to scan.

**Applies to:** Any document that carries the QR, including one you render.

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0), apartado 3 — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/DetalleEspecificacTecnCodigoQRfactura.pdf

**Incorrect:** Printing the QR on its own, or with a label in a smaller font than the invoice lines.

**Correct:** Printing «QR tributario:» centred above the QR, at the same size as the invoice data.

**Related:** QRC-006, QRC-008

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf#rendering-your-own-pdf

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/QRC-007.md

## QRC-008

**The QR goes once, at the top of the first page**

`MUST` · AEAT criterion · Impact: medium · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Place the QR at the beginning of the invoice, before its content, near the top margin and preferably centred (otherwise top left). On an invoice of several pages it appears once, on the first page.

**Why:** AEAT's specification fixes where the recipient finds the code; a QR repeated or buried in the footer departs from it.

**Applies to:** Any document that carries the QR, including one you render.

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0), apartado 3 — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/DetalleEspecificacTecnCodigoQRfactura.pdf
- AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU, Remisión de información por el receptor / QR — https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/iva/sistemas-informaticos-facturacion-verifactu/preguntas-frecuentes/posibilidad-remision-informacion-factura-parte-receptor.html

**Incorrect:** Repeating the QR in the footer of every page.

**Correct:** Printing it once, at the top of page one, centred between the margins.

**Related:** QRC-007, QRC-009

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf#rendering-your-own-pdf

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/QRC-008.md

## QRC-009

**Keep a blank margin around the QR**

`MUST` · AEAT criterion · Impact: low · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Leave at least 2 mm of blank space on all four sides of the QR (6 mm recommended), with enough contrast against the background.

**Why:** Without a quiet zone, text or lines next to the code stop it from scanning.

**Applies to:** Any document that carries the QR, including one you render.

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0), apartado 3 — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/DetalleEspecificacTecnCodigoQRfactura.pdf

**Incorrect:** Placing the QR flush against a table border.

**Correct:** Keeping a white margin around it on every side.

**Related:** QRC-003, QRC-008

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf#rendering-your-own-pdf

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/QRC-009.md

## QRC-010

**A structured e-invoice carries the QR URL as a field**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

When you send an invoice as a structured electronic invoice, include the qr_url as a separate field; the QR image itself is then not needed. A PDF still shows the QR image.

**Why:** In a structured file there is no image to scan: the URL is how the recipient reaches AEAT's check.

**Applies to:** Invoices you send as structured e-invoices (Facturae, UBL and similar).

**Legal basis:**

- Orden HAC/1177/2024, art. 20.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2024-22138#a2-2
- Orden HAC/1177/2024, art. 20.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2024-22138#a2-2

**Incorrect:** Converting the invoice to a structured format and dropping the QR data.

**Correct:** Mapping verifactu.qr_url to its own field of the structured invoice.

**Related:** QRC-005, QRC-001

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/qr-and-pdf#rendering-your-own-pdf

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/QRC-010.md
